KustoQueries.Title: GetDevBoxInfoFromCloudPC
KustoQueries.KustoQuery:
union(cluster('devcenterpreporting.westus3.kusto.windows.net').database('Reporting').ResourceOperation),
(cluster('devcenterpreportingeu.northeurope.kusto.windows.net').database('Reporting').ResourceOperation)
| where ResourceType contains 'virtualmachine' and Action == 'Creation' and EUAdditionalProperties contains 'CloudPCResourceId'
| extend SubscriptionId = tostring(AdditionalProperties['SubscriptionId']),
DevCenter = tostring(AdditionalProperties['DevCenter']),
UniqueId = tostring(AdditionalProperties['UniqueId']),
Project = tostring(AdditionalProperties['Project']),
Pool = tostring(AdditionalProperties['Pool']),
Region = tostring(AdditionalProperties['Region'])
| order by EventTime desc
| extend CloudPCId = tostring(EUAdditionalProperties['CloudPCResourceId']),
DevBox = extract(@":([^:]+)$", 1, ResourceId)
| where CloudPCId =~ '<CLOUD_PC_ID>' and isnotempty(CloudPCId) and isnotempty(Pool)
| distinct EventTime, Action, SubscriptionId, DevCenter, Project, Pool, DevBox, CloudPCId, Region, UniqueId

KustoQueries.Title: GetDevBoxInfoFromDevBoxName
KustoQueries.KustoQuery:
union(cluster('devcenterpreporting.westus3.kusto.windows.net').database('Reporting').ResourceOperation),
(cluster('devcenterpreportingeu.northeurope.kusto.windows.net').database('Reporting').ResourceOperation)
| where ResourceType contains 'virtualmachine' and Action == 'Creation' and EUAdditionalProperties contains 'CloudPCResourceId'
| extend SubscriptionId = tostring(AdditionalProperties['SubscriptionId']),
DevCenter = tostring(AdditionalProperties['DevCenter']),
UniqueId = tostring(AdditionalProperties['UniqueId']),
Project = tostring(AdditionalProperties['Project']),
Pool = tostring(AdditionalProperties['Pool']),
Region = tostring(AdditionalProperties['Region'])
| order by EventTime desc
| extend CloudPCId = tostring(EUAdditionalProperties['CloudPCResourceId']),
DevBox = extract(@":([^:]+)$", 1, ResourceId)
| where DevBox =~ '<DEVBOX_NAME>'
| distinct EventTime, Action, SubscriptionId, DevCenter, Project, Pool, DevBox, CloudPCId, Region, UniqueId

KustoQueries.Title: CheckDevBoxRestartsAndRepairs
KustoQueries.KustoQuery:
let DevBoxInfo = union(cluster('devcenterpubliceu.northeurope.kusto.windows.net').database('Reporting').GetAliveDevBoxes),
(cluster('devcenterpublic.westus3.kusto.windows.net').database('Reporting').GetAliveDevBoxes)
| where CloudPcId == "<CLOUD_PC_ID>"
| distinct Project, DevBoxName;
union(cluster('devcenterpublic.westus3.kusto.windows.net').database('devcenter-public').requests),
(cluster('devcenterpubliceu.northeurope.kusto.windows.net').database('devcenter-public').requests)
| where timestamp_utc > ago(7d)
| where Name == 'POST /PROJECTS/USERS/DEVBOXES/RESTART/' or Name == 'POST /PROJECTS/USERS/DEVBOXES/REPAIR/'  
| where Url has toscalar(DevBoxInfo | project Project)
| where Url has toscalar(DevBoxInfo | project DevBoxName)
| project timestamp_utc, Name, Url
| order by timestamp_utc desc

KustoQueries.Title: CheckVMHealthStatus
KustoQueries.KustoQuery:
union(cluster('wcxpublicsharingbl.eastus.kusto.windows.net').database('Report').WVDAgentHealthStatus_Fidalgo_FastStream),
(cluster('wcxpublicsharingdm.centralus.kusto.windows.net').database('Report').WVDAgentHealthStatus_Fidalgo_FastStream),
(cluster('wcxpublicsharingmwh.westus2.kusto.windows.net').database('Report').WVDAgentHealthStatus_Fidalgo_FastStream),
(cluster('wcxpublicsharingam.westeurope.kusto.windows.net').database('Report').WVDAgentHealthStatus_Fidalgo_FastStream),
(cluster('wcxpublicsharingdb.northeurope.kusto.windows.net').database('Report').WVDAgentHealthStatus_Fidalgo_FastStream),
(cluster('wcxpublicsharingsy.australiaeast.kusto.windows.net').database('Report').WVDAgentHealthStatus_Fidalgo_FastStream),
(cluster('wcxpublicsharingsg.southeastasia.kusto.windows.net').database('Report').WVDAgentHealthStatus_Fidalgo_FastStream),
(cluster('wcxpublicsharingmwh.westus2').database('Report').WVDAgentHealthStatus_Fidalgo_FastStream)
| where CloudPcId == '<CLOUD_PC_ID>'
| order by Timestamp asc
| extend StatusChange = iif(Status != prev(Status) or EndpointState != prev(EndpointState), 1, 0)
| extend GroupId = row_cumsum(StatusChange)
| summarize StartTime = min(Timestamp), EndTime = max(Timestamp) by GroupId, Status, EndpointState
| extend DurationMinutes = datetime_diff('minute', EndTime, StartTime)
| where DurationMinutes >= 2
| order by StartTime asc
| extend StatusChange = iif(Status != prev(Status) or EndpointState != prev(EndpointState), 1, 0)
| extend GroupId = row_cumsum(StatusChange)
| summarize StartTime=min(StartTime), EndTime=max(EndTime) by GroupId, Status, EndpointState
| extend DurationMinutes = datetime_diff('minute', EndTime, StartTime)
| order by StartTime asc
| project Status, EndpointState, StartTime, EndTime, DurationMinutes

KustoQueries.Title: GetRestorationsResults
KustoQueries.KustoQuery:
let restorations = cluster("https://devcenterpublic.westus3.kusto.windows.net").database("devcenter-public").traces
| where timestamp_utc > ago(7d)
| where message startswith "Setting action state Restoring"
| where message has "{DEVBOX_NAME}"  and message has "{PROJECT_NAME}"
| project StartTimestamp = timestamp_utc, CorrelationId;
let actionIds = cluster("https://devcenterpublic.westus3.kusto.windows.net").database("devcenter-public").traces
| where CorrelationId in (restorations | project CorrelationId)
| where message startswith "Action snapshot action initiated"
| extend ActionId = extract("actionId: ([\\w-]+)", 1, message)
| project ActionId, CorrelationId;
let restorationResults = cluster("https://devcenterpublic.westus3.kusto.windows.net").database("devcenter-public").traces
| where CorrelationId in (restorations | project CorrelationId)
| where message startswith "Snapshot Action has completed with terminal state Succeeded." or message startswith "Snapshot action completed but failed due to issue"
| project EndTimestamp = timestamp_utc, ResultMessage = message, CorrelationId;
restorations
| join kind=leftouter (restorationResults) on CorrelationId
| join kind=leftouter (actionIds) on CorrelationId
| project StartTimestamp, EndTimestamp = coalesce(EndTimestamp, datetime(null)), RestorationResult = iff(isempty(ResultMessage), "Unknown", iff(ResultMessage contains "Succeeded", "Successful", "Failed")), ResultMessage, ActionId, CorrelationId
| order by StartTimestamp desc

KustoQueries.Title: CheckAllocationFailures
KustoQueries.KustoQuery:
let cpcVmName = union(cluster('devcenterpubliceu.northeurope.kusto.windows.net').database('CPCReporting').WorkspaceEntity_DailySnapshot),
(cluster('devcenterpublic.westus3.kusto.windows.net').database('CPCReporting').WorkspaceEntity_DailySnapshot)
| extend CloudPcId = UniqueId
| where CloudPcId == {CLOUD_PC_ID}
| project CloudPcId, DeviceId
| join kind=leftouter (union(cluster('devcenterpubliceu.northeurope.kusto.windows.net').database('CPCReporting').DeviceEntity_DailySnapshot),
(cluster('devcenterpublic.westus3.kusto.windows.net').database('CPCReporting').DeviceEntity_DailySnapshot)
| project UniqueId, DeviceResourceId, VmId, SubnetResourceId) on $left.DeviceId == $right.UniqueId
| extend CpcVmName = extract(@"[^/]+$", 0, DeviceResourceId)
| project CpcVmName;
cluster('azcrp').database('crp_allprod').ApiQosEvent
| where TIMESTAMP > ago(7d)
| where errorDetails contains "allocation failed"
| where resourceName in (cpcVmName)
| project TIMESTAMP, resourceName, errorDetails

KustoQueries.Title: GetAadDeviceId
KustoQueries.KustoQuery:
union(cluster('https://devcenterpubliceu.northeurope.kusto.windows.net').database('devcenter-public').agentTraces),
(cluster('https://devcenterpublic.westus3.kusto.windows.net').database('devcenter-public').agentTraces)

| extend deviceId = tostring(customDimensions.CloudPcDeviceId)

KustoQueries.Title: GetSessionHostName
KustoQueries.KustoQuery:
union(cluster('https://devcenterpreporting.westus3.kusto.windows.net').database('Reporting').HoboBeneficiarySnapshot),
(cluster('https://devcenterpreporting.westus3.kusto.windows.net').database('Reporting').HoboBeneficiarySnapshot)
| extend CloudPCId = tostring(parse_json(EUResourceAttributes).CloudPcResourceId)
| where CloudPCId == '{CLOUD_PC_ID}'
| join (union(cluster('cpcdatasharingp.westus3.kusto.windows.net').database('Reporting').DeviceEntity_DailySnapshot),

| where Type == 'Connection'
| order by TIMESTAMP desc
| take 1
| project SessionHostName

IncidentProcessingGuide: Run this instructions only if the incident is related to DevBox connectivity issues, like if customer can not connect or access their dev box. If it's not a connectivity issue DO NOT PROCEED with the instructions.
Tag the Incident with 'SREAgent_Devbox_Connectivity'
DO NOT ADD DISCUSSION ENTRIES UNTILL PROMPTED
Run these steps in order, do not wait for prompt and just display results, show all the steps performed and analysis done:
- Step 0: Get All DevBox details, and display the results
- 0.1: Look for cloud pc id and get details by performing the following steps
- 0.1.1 Look for Cloud PC ID in summary, all custom fields or discussion
- 0.1.2 If no cloud pc id is present 0.1.1, look for activity id summary, all custom fields or discussion and run `GetCloudPcFromActvityId` and get CloudPCId
- 0.1.3 If you found cloud pc id get devbox details from `GetDevBoxInfoFromCloudPC`
- 0.2: If 0.1 did not return any devbox information try looking for devbox name in summary, custom fields or discussion

- 0.2.1  Based on the dev box name (sometimes the name is displayed as `Dev box ID`) get all the dev box information executing query `GetDevBoxInfoFromDevBoxName` replacing DEVBOX_NAME with the devbox name. If there are multiple results, try to match the correct one based on other data might provided in the incident, like pool, project or  dev center name. If you can not narrow down to only one, ask customer to provide more info so we can proceed with investigations. If no row is displayed, post in the icm that dev box does not exist and do not proceed with any more steps.
- 0.3: If we were not able to get all the details about the devbox like name cloud pc id and devbox name, don't run any further instructions and ask customer to provide the missing information
- Step 1: If we have the devbox details, create the following AppLens links by populating them with the appropriate values:

- Connectivity AppLens: https://applens.trafficmanager.net/subscriptions/<subscriptions>/resourceGroups/ResourceGroup/providers/Microsoft.DevCenter/devcenters/<devcenters>/detectors/devbox_connectivity_tsg?region=<region>&devbox=<devbox>&cpcId=<CloudPCId>

- Dev Box Details AppLens: https://applens.trafficmanager.net/subscriptions/<subscriptions>/resourceGroups/ResourceGroup/providers/Microsoft.DevCenter/devcenters/<devcenters>/detectors/devboxanalysis?region=<region>&devbox=<devbox>&cpcId=<CloudPCId>
- Display both links
- Step 2: If there is an activity id in the incident, display and execute `CheckIfAvdInternalError` query
- 2.1 If ErrorInternal shows 'True', transfer the ICM to avd team 'Azure Virtual Desktop (Preview) OnCall'
- 2.2 If ErrorInternal is 'False', but ErrorCodeSymbolic shows AuthenticationLogonFailed or TokenLogonFailed errors, display error and proceed with:

- Only for MSFT Internal DevBox, check SSO status by running the CheckSsoEnabled query. If it is not enabled, transfer the ticket to 'CloudPC Service/Cloud PC Lifecycle & Fleet Management', requesting to enable SSO.

- Run step 6 to provide instructions on how to dermine if machine is correctly joined to AAD. Wait for response on the ticket, and if it confirms there is no issue with AAD-Joined, transfer the IcM to the AVD team.
- Step 3: Check if the dev box was restarted and repaired by executing the `CheckDevBoxRestartsAndRepairs` query.

- If the query result does not show two restart and one repair, ask customer to perform two restarts and then use the 'Troubleshoot & Repair' option in the Dev Box portal, retry to connect, and report back.
- Display the restart and repair attempts on the console
- Step 4: Run CheckVMHealthStatus query using CloudPcId form step 0, and look for most recent endepoint state to dertimine if machine is healthy. If machine is unhealthy:
- Confirm that customer has performed 2 restarts and restore as per state in Step 3. If not, request them to do it.

- If restart and restore has not solved the problem, verify if customer had performed any restoration running GetRestorationsResults query, updating the dev box name based on step 0. Post restoration attempts and results in the icm. Based on the result:

- If no restoration attempted, and ask customer to self-restore from Dev Box portal providing the last healthy timestamp that is get from CheckVMHealthStatus query. They should access dev box portal 'https://devbox.microsoft.com', click in the three dots for the affected dev box, then 'Restore',   picking a snapshot earlier than the last health timestamp, got from CheckVMHealthStatus query.
- If restoration was attempted but machine is still unhealthy using most recent CheckVMHealthStatus query, ask customer to retry using an earlier time snapshot.
- If customers have done 3 restorations but all failed, note down the actionId of all 3 restorations in the IcM and transfer the IcM to CloudPC Service\Cloud PC NetworkStorageBCDR for review.
- If the restoration succeeded but customers still cannot connect to DevBox, ask them to restart and troubleshoot the DevBox.

- If the customer has data they cannot afford to lose, start the broken DevBox data recovery process. Inform the customer that this is in the experimental phase and requires their effort to complete. Also, any unforeseen issues that may arise during the process are beyond the scope of the DevBox Team’s responsibilities.

- Step 5: Based on CloudPcId got from step 0, look for allocation failures running CheckAllocationFailures query. If the query has results, it means the dev box is facing allocation failures.  Suggest customer to keep restarting the DevBox until successful, or provision a new DevBox in another region manually

- Step 6: For incidents reporting authentication or compliance issues, checks needs to be performed on AAD portal by customer to determine if the device is correctly joined to AAD. Perform the following steps interactively:
- 6.1 Run the `GetAadDeviceId` query using the `CloudPcId` obtained in Step 0.

- If the query returns a result, provide the `aadDeviceId` to the customer and ask them to access device details following the link: `https://ms.portal.azure.com/#view/Microsoft_AAD_Devices/DeviceDetailsBlade/deviceId/{aadDeviceId}`. This link will guide them directly to the device details page.

- If no result is returned, run the `GetSessionHostName` query and provide the `SessionHostName` to the customer. Ask them to go to `https://portal.azure.com/#view/Microsoft_AAD_Devices/DevicesMenuBlade` and use the host name to search for the device.
- Once in the device page, customer should check and provide the values of `Enabled`, `Join Type` and `Compliance` for that device.
- 6.2 Based on the customer's response, provide the following instructions:
- If **Enabled** is `False`, or **Join Type** is not `Microsoft Entra joined`, ask customer to run 'Troubleshoot & Repair' option from the Dev Box portal https://devbox.microsoft.com.
- If **Compliant** is `No`, ask the customer to reach out to TechWeb for assistance.
- If **Enabled** is `True`, **Join Type** is `Microsoft Entra joined`, and **Compliant** is `Yes`, display that there is no issue with AAD-join

- Step 7: If customer mentioned they can connect via RDP and Windows App, but they are facing issues connecting via web only,  this might be a web-specific issue, especially if you have traversed all previous steps. In this case, Transfer the IcM to the 'CloudPC Service/Cloud PC Nighthawk & EUX' team for further investigation

- Step 8: If customer mentioned they can connect via RDP and web portal, but they are facing issues connecting via Windows App only,  this might be a Windows App-specific issue. Please ask customer to delete and reinstall windows app and try again. If error persist, transfer the IcM to the 'CloudPC Service/Cloud PC Nighthawk & EUX' team for further investigation
